items.title: Passage of school safety law pushed
items.description: The Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) is pushing for the passage of a Comprehensive School Safety Act after the recent school violence in South Cotabato, which resulted in the deaths of three students and wounding of eight others.

items.title: Ombudsman pushes civil service eligibility for BSK officials
items.description: At the minimum, barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (BSK) officials should have civil service eligibility, as they are “the frontline of service.”

items.title: ICC prosecutor adds 8 incidents in Duterte case
items.description: The prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has included eight additional incidents in its crimes against humanity case filed against former president Rodrigo Duterte.

items.title: VP Sara’s business deals next at trial
items.description: House prosecutors are expected to focus on conflict of interest arising from Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged businesses as the impeachment trial resumes today.

items.title: Pacquiao wants NAPC regional offices
items.description: To bring the government’s poverty reduction and social reform programs closer to the people, newly installed head of the National Anti-Poverty Commission (NAPC) Manny Pacquiao pushed for the establishment of satellite offices in every region.

items.title: DPWH summons Taguig contractors for CDO violation
items.description: The Department of Public Works and Highways has issued show-cause orders to contractors in Taguig who allegedly continued construction activities despite existing cease-and-desist directives.

items.title: Groups mark martial law with corruption protest
items.description: Youth and student groups returned to the streets yesterday to demand an end to corruption and political dynasties, saying the campaign for accountability must go beyond investigations, congressional hearings and arrests.

items.title: DFA affirms one-China; Taiwan to open Cebu office
items.description: The Philippines’ one-China policy remains unchanged, but it does not stop the country from pursuing economic, cultural and functional cooperation with Taiwan.

items.title: Comelec to Congress: Fast-track anti-dynasty law
items.description: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) is urging Congress to fast-track the passage of an Anti-Political Dynasty Law so it can be enacted in time for the filing of certificates of candidacy for the 2028 elections.

items.title: Senate tackles today VP impeachment vote threshold
items.description: Senators are expected to go into caucus today in an attempt to resolve the question on the conviction threshold for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

items.description: Filipina wushu standout Agatha Wong delivers her Asian Games swan song, finishing 10th in the women's taijiquan and taijijian event

items.description: James Payosing, an NCAA champion and a Finals MVP with the San Beda Red Lions, brings the same winning mentality to the UP Fighting Maroons
